# Brand Assets & Housekeeping

A small maintenance release. No configuration changes are needed.

### Brand assets
- The Emby icon and logo now ship inside the integration (`custom_components/emby_modern/brand/`).
- Home Assistant 2026.3 and later use these directly, so the integration shows its proper branding in Settings, the Marketplace and on device pages.
- Thanks to frenck for the contribution (#2).

### Housekeeping
- Removed compiled Python cache files that were accidentally included in v1.2.7. They had no effect on how the integration runs.
- Added a `.gitignore` so they can't be included again.
- README: credits updated.

### Upgrade notes
- Update from **Settings → Updates**, then restart Home Assistant.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sambarlick/emby/compare/v1.2.7...v1.2.8
